title: Fishing Gun
description: Fishing guns that shoot multiple lines(Comes with custom-enchantments)
body:
# Fishing Guns
### I do not like new fishing mechanics, so i wanted to have this.
Fishing Guns fire multiple lines at once.

![Fishing with mecha](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d31cf09ab4faea281d627d1ce69f826d8fd7f39_0.webp)

### Tiers:
1. **Copper** : 4 lines · 64 durability · 1.0× reel speed - your entry-level gun, built from scratch.
2. **Iron** : 8 lines · 128 durability · 1.5× reel  speed
3. **Gold** : 12 lines · 32 durability · 2.0× reel speed
4. **Diamond** : 16 lines · 256 durability · 2.5× reel speed
5. **Netherite** : 20 lines · 512 durability · 3.0× reel speed
6. **Mecha** : 32 lines · 1024 durability · 4.0× reel speed - the top tier, with the widest spread and the exclusive enchantment.

   ![Guns_recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c62f07404108fb2a993ba17f42fde57f1697356.png)

Two custom enchantments:

Patient Angler - extends the bite window, giving you more time to reel in before the catch slips away. For each level, it extends it by a second.

Auto-Reel - exclusive to the Mecha Fishing Gun, automatically reels in each line the moment something bites and casts a fresh bobber back out, for hands-free fishing.
